description: Deletes the checks CookiePal stored under one install ID. Run it from the plugin before the ID is removed from the machine, because once the ID is gone there is nothing left to look the checks up by. It answers with how many were deleted and how many remain: only a run reporting no remainder has finished, and running it again deletes just what is left. An ID that stored nothing reports zero of both. It also unlinks the ID from any CookiePal account it was connected to. No account needed.

installId.description: The install ID to erase. Every check stored under it is deleted.

name: forget_install

deleted.description: How many stored checks were deleted. Zero is a normal answer.

remaining.description: Stored checks that could not be deleted this time. Normally zero; when it is not, keep the install ID and run this again, which deletes only what is left.

unlinked.description: Whether the install ID was linked to a CookiePal account, and that link removed.

title: Delete the checks stored under an install ID
